description: An agent that tells an equity analyst which periods of a company's SEC-reported revenue series can be trusted, with every finding cited to Zetaris rows.

meterless_engines.name: Markovian
meterless_engines.feature: Drives every run: one investigation step per chunk inside a bounded context, code-written carry-over between chunks, chunk cap and deadline, JSONL run record in logs/markovian-<run_id>.jsonl
tests: tests/test_markovian_conformance.py (eff-001, snap-001, snap-002, ovl-001, lab-001, ref-001, mrk-001, cfg-001, ported from the upstream conformance runner)
meterless_engines.generator: injected; the engine never calls a model itself

models.nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b: Analyst explanations, engine reflection, Planner company resolution

model_provider.routing: a fixed Nemotron model per agent, never meterless/auto; the receipt's routed_model is written to every model_call trace line
